meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

howto.what: 将 Flask/Django/FastAPI 等 Python 代码部署到 Azure App Service Linux。资源组、计划、Web 应用缺失时自动创建;按框架设启动命令,部署后打印后续说明并结束。
howto.when: 当用户提到“Flask App Service”“Django App Service”“FastAPI App Service”等短语,或要求把 Python 部署到 Azure App Service 时触发。

howto.what_en: Deploys Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. Auto-creates missing resource group/plan/web app; detects framework, sets startup command, deploys, then prints the post-deploy message and ends.
